description: Doench et al. 2016 "Rule Set 2" / Azimuth on-target efficacy score for an SpCas9 guide, conventionally in 0..1 (higher = predicted more active) — the "Doench '16" efficiency score reported by CRISPOR. Rule Set 2 is a trained gradient-boosted-tree model, reproduced here from Microsoft Research's Azimuth model. Input is the model's 30-nt context: 4 nt upstream + 20 nt protospacer + 3 nt PAM (must be NGG) + 3 nt downstream, A/C/G/T only. Pass amino_acid_cut_position and percent_peptide together to use Azimuth's gene-context (full) model instead of the sequence-only one; percent_peptide = -1 is Azimuth's "no gene position" sentinel and is answered with the sequence-only model, as in the reference. Call to rank guides by the published on-target activity model.

context_30mer.description: 30-nt context: 4 nt upstream + 20 nt protospacer + 3 nt NGG PAM + 3 nt downstream.

amino_acid_cut_position.description: Optional amino-acid position of the cut site in the target protein, >= 0 (requires percent_peptide); enables the gene-context model. Ignored when percent_peptide = -1.

percent_peptide.description: Optional cut position as a percentage 0..100 along the coding sequence, or -1 for Azimuth's "no gene position" sentinel (which falls back to the sequence-only model); requires amino_acid_cut_position.

score.description: Predicted on-target activity, conventionally 0..1 (higher = more active).

errors.message: Context 30-mer cannot be null or empty.
amino_acid_cut_position and percent_peptide must be supplied together (gene-context model) or both omitted.

Rule Set 2 expects an SpCas9 NGG PAM at offsets 25-26 of the 30-nt context.
Rule Set 2 percent-peptide must be in [0, 100], or -1 for Azimuth's "no gene position" sentinel (which selects the sequence-only model).
Rule Set 2 amino-acid cut position must be >= 0 (a residue count; Azimuth's own fixture spans 0..499).
